title: Chapter 6253: Knocked Unconscious
content:
Chapter 6253: Knocked Unconscious

Chapter 6253: Knocked Unconscious

Ruyi Monarch was furious and Skyraiser Crown Prince's expression wasn't much better.

"I want to see who will exterminate my clan." Ruyi Monarch's aura felt like a mountain pressing down on one's chest.

"Oh my, so strong!" Black Witch Monarch acted as if he had just pissed his pants and hid behind Li Qiye: "Young Noble, he's too strong, give him a beating."

The youths were at a loss for words. This old man caused the most trouble on top of always running the fastest. They wondered if he was strong or just a big-mouth coward.

"I got this." The girl jumped down from Li Qiye's embrace and raised her fist.

Did this girl want to fight a pseudo-emperor?

"The world is so strange now, I suppose a newborn calf doesn't know to be afraid of a tiger." One cultivator said.

Li Qiye grabbed her and said: "Forget it, let's leave for the fun area."

"Okay." The girl obediently followed his wish.

"Can we get down without being burned to ashes by the tribulation flames?" Li Xian looked down and sensed the terrible heat.

"A yawn can extinguish them, so tiny." The monarch looked down and said.

"Yawn then." Li Qiye told him.

"If I can, I would be an immortal. I was talking about you, Young Noble." He responded.

"Another embarrassing moment." The princess said.

"Fool, how can a mortal extinguish a tribulation flame?" Ruyi Monarch shook his head.

"You're the fool, it is nothing compared to the young noble." Black Witch Monarch coldly uttered.

"Do as you wish." Ruyi Monarch had no intention of escalating the issue.

"Pseudo-emperors can't withstand the flames, you will be incinerated the moment you jump down." An expert shook her head.

"That's because they're pseudo-emperors, our young noble isn't one." Black Witch Monarch said arrogantly.

"What are you saying?" Others found him disrespectful toward the strongest cultivators.

"I will admit inferiority if you prove yourself against these flames." Ruyi Monarch said.

"Failing means turning to ashes. Otherwise, I will turn you all to ashes myself." Skyraiser Crown Prince gazed intimidatingly at the group, possessing murderous urges.

Li Qiye glanced at him and said: "Do you wish to die?"

The crown prince's expression soured at the mortal's impudence.

"Have it your way then, fool!" His aura intensified, causing others to stagger backward. No one could stop him from killing even if they wanted to.

"Crown Prince, you mustn't." Bronze-blade shook his head.

"Senior, you don't need to worry about this, I am merely obliging someone's death w-" The crown prince's eyes gleamed chillingly.

"Bam!" He couldn't finish his sentence before being struck on the back of the head and lost consciousness, falling straight to the ground.

The crowd was rightfully shocked and once they regained their wits, they realized the attacker was none other than the little girl. This doubled their astonishment.

No one saw how she got behind him or knocked him out with a single punch. Not to mention strangers, Orchidcore and the others with knowledge of her identity were stunned.

"Let's see if you will disrespect my ancestor next time." She declared while waving her fist.

"H-how can this be?" Others stammered upon digesting this development.

"It can't..." An ancestor responded.

The other pseudo-emperors couldn't knock the crown prince out with one punch yet this girl did it.

"So she is really an ancestor..." Orchidcore's knees buckled.

His group was curious about her identity and history, never questioning her power. After all, how strong could she be given her age? Now, it became clear that she could obliterate them with a single punch. Fortunately, no one disrespected her during the first meeting.

Bronze-blade and Coldblade took a deep breath. Ruyi Monarch felt a chill coursing down his spine as he staggered backward.

The monarch knew the crown prince's power. If he couldn't see her movement, calling her a "monster" was insufficient.

"And you don't know anything else about your ancestor?" Princess Chen whispered to Mu Hu.

"I don't..." Mu Hu responded.

"Anyone else dares to disrespect the ancestor?" The girl waved her fist and glared at the crowd.

None challenged her; some lowered their head in avoidance.

"We're done here? Let's go." Li Qiye gestured for her to return before staring at the leaf.

"Yes, we can go." She said happily.

With that, Li Qiye raised his hand forward while all eyes were on the duo.
